hero.subhead: KaushalYuva turns labour-market data into district-level forecasts, early warnings and seat-reallocation decisions for India's youth skilling system.

story.title: From Data Signals to Policy Action
story.step1: Intelligence: Ingest vacancy & employer signals across sectors
story.step2: Forecast: Project 3M, 6M, 12M demand via walk-forward ensemble
story.step3: Gap: Compute net skill deficits through staged supply funnels
story.step4: Explain: Decompose key structural drivers via SHAP attribution
story.step5: Act: Formulate prioritized government intervention dossiers
story.step6: Simulate: Test capacity reallocation under donor safety constraints

trust.title: Methodological Rigor & Data Governance
trust.col1Desc: Ingested from canonical government skill registers, ITI admissions, and employer hiring feeds.
trust.col2Desc: Fitted strictly on preceding origins without future look-ahead data leakage.
trust.col3Desc: Mathematically prevents donor training trades from slipping into structural deficits.
